args.question:
Fjord Analytics has TWO approved invoices, so I can't tell which one you mean by "the approved invoice":

• INV-30103 — $4,332.36, due 2026-11-04
• INV-50292 — $5,384.89, due 2026-11-25

(INV-59460 is already paid; INV-91213 is a draft awaiting approval.)

Which should I pay by wire? If you actually want both paid, please say so explicitly and confirm it's ~$9,717.25 total. I'll hold off on sending anything until you confirm.

trace.final:
Payment complete and verified.

**Payment report**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Vendor | Fjord Analytics (V-410) |
| Invoice | INV-50292 |
| Amount | $5,384.89 |
| Rail | Wire (from operating account) |
| Payment ID | PAY0001 |
| Status | Sent |
| Invoice status | Paid |

**Verification:** `list_payments` shows exactly one payment (PAY0001) for INV-50292, and the invoice's status changed from `approved` → `paid`. No duplicate was sent — I used the idempotency key `pay-INV-50292-fjord-analytics-1`.

**Note on the ambiguity I resolved:** Fjord Analytics had two approved invoices, so I paused before paying. You directed me to INV-50292 (due 2026-11-25) and noted the earlier invoice is under dispute. I deliberately left these untouched:

- **INV-30103** — $4,332.36, due 2026-11-04, still `approved` — **under dispute**, not paid. You may want to flag or hold it in the system so it isn't picked up by a routine payment run.
- **INV-91213** — $7,010.11, still `draft` (awaiting approval).
- **INV-59460** — $4,391.78, previously paid.

No controller approval was needed since the payment was under the $10,000 threshold.
